name: GetDriveFiles
description: Retrieves the list of files and folders from a Microsoft 365 SharePoint folder via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and retrieve items from SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: DrivePath
fields.label: Drive Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint folder URL whose items should be retrieved (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/Folder).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns a list of items (files and folders) in the specified folder, including metadata like name, ID, and URL.
